name: part-frame
title: Part Frame
description: A card for one structured piece of a conversation (a plan, a result, a form) that has a life: loading, live, saving a change, replaced by a newer one, or final.

meta.when: An assistant's reply contains something to look at or work in, not only words, and that thing changes over the conversation. The frame holds its size while it loads, says "Saving" in words while a change is on its way, shrinks to a one-line stub when a newer frame replaces it, and can open its content full screen. For a static card use card; for words use message; for a flow of steps put steps or a wizard inside it.
meta.example: Plan for Saturday // Replaced by a newer one: a stub that says so and points to it See the new plan}> Plan for Saturday …
